facts.fact: Vero 钻平台下发现蛛网，声称要与蜘蛛讲和
facts.anchor: where there are webs there are spiders

facts.fact: 取零食路上 Kayla 惊觉：这已是她想要的日常
facts.anchor: this is very domestic. When did this become something I wanted?

facts.fact: Aaron 现身玉米地：她手脚失能源于药物，他自称等了她多年
facts.anchor: But the drug speeds up the inevitable. You were never getting away from me, care bear

facts.fact: Aaron 承认 PI 逼他提前动手，并用「他们瞒你=不爱」离间
facts.anchor: I was running out of time

facts.fact: 他被捕入狱多年后仍找到她：监视在先、现身在后
facts.anchor: You were never getting away from me

facts.fact: 箱内 Kayla 无声反驳：他正是她锁门两遍与搬家换城的原因
facts.anchor: You’re the reason I check the locks twice. You’re the reason I moved

facts.fact: 填土声中 Cave 的第三则谜语响起：玉米田吞足迹、垄尽头是黑暗——「我是稻草人，现在凑够两个了」
facts.anchor: I am the field that swallows your footprints
